verdict.rationale: Raygun documents a generic 'external access token' for API/Deployments access (raygun-docs-8), but there is no evidence of scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific credential issuance (e.g., role-based API keys, permission scopes for AI agents). The MCP server exists (raygun-probe-3) but no docs describe credential scoping for it. Missing for 10: scoped/role-based API keys, documented least-privilege permission model, agent-specific credential issuance guidance.
